story:
Why this one matters: majors and the FedEx Cup are finished. The European flagship is not. After three rounds at Wentworth, the AP board has two names at 13 under and no trophy.

AP: Filippo Celli 68-66-69 and Manuel Elvira 69-66-68, both 203. Alejandro Del Rey 69-71-64, JJ Spaun 70-66-68 and Johannes Veerman 68-72-64, all 204. Rory McIlroy 69-67-69, Adam Scott 67-67-71, Joaquin Niemann 71-67-67, Kristoffer Reitan 71-70-64 and Davis Bryant 68-70-67, all 205. Ryan Gerard, the 36-hole leader, 67-65-75, 207.

CBS: Gerard five bogeys in his first 14 Saturday holes, two late birdies, 9 under. McIlroy a kick-in eagle on 18 after a dart from 231 yards. FOX and Today's Golfer print Celli and Elvira as 54-hole co-leaders. Round 4 is 20 September. Presidents Cup is still 24-27 September at Medinah. Print the 54-hole board. Do not print a winner.
stakes: One round left at the DP World Tour flagship. A 54-hole lead is not a trophy.
rivalryAngle: Celli and Elvira versus a Sunday group that still includes McIlroy, Spaun, Scott and a fading Gerard.
